claim: No three-qutrit Heisenberg (Pauli) group acts on the 27 of E6 as its Schroedinger module, by any operators preserving the E6 cubic up to scale -- monomial, non-monomial or projective. Conjugation by the Pauli group splits gl(27) into 729 distinct one-dimensional character spaces, so e6 would have to be spanned by 78 Pauli operators; but a bracket-closed set of Pauli labels has connected components equal to span minus radical, so a simple Pauli-spanned algebra has dimension 3^a - 3^b in {8, 24, 72, 80, 216, 240, 648, 720, 728}, and 78 is not one of them. This closes the loophole left open by TOE w33_e6_gauge_three_qutrit_pauli_firewall.

lemmas.L1: the 729 Pauli operators are a basis of gl(27) and carry distinct conjugation characters, so any conjugation-stable subspace is Pauli-spanned; this is what makes the result projective-proof
lemmas.L2: each connected component of a bracket-closed label set equals span minus radical

positiveHalf: the two-qutrit case is sl(9) = su(9) = A8, exactly the W(3,3) twist of E8 (68df33f), which is also the local group the Standard Models of 5b3f3ad sit inside; qutrit registers are natively an SU(9) structure, never an E6 one

naiveTestThatFails.reading: Pauli-invariant cubics exist in a 14-dimensional family; the question is whether E6's cubic is among them, and it is not

whatSurvives.carrier: the 729 = 27 x 27 vector-space intertwiner, as its own certificate states
whatSurvives.geometric_qutrits: the three fixed-point flavour qutrits remain physical (2365e59, hep-ph/0611020); only the gauge-side three are excluded

status: exact finite computation over F3^6 plus exact character arithmetic; L2 verified on every connected component of 400 randomised closures
boundary: The theorem is about operators on the 27 that preserve the E6 cubic up to scale, which is the condition for preserving the 27^3 Yukawa coupling. It does not constrain operators that act on other factors of the string Hilbert space.
